sloka: अथ वैश्रवणो देवस्तत्र कालेन केनचित् ।आगतः पितरं द्रष्टुं पुष्पकेण धनेश्वरः ।। ७.९.४० ॥
transliteration: atha vaiśravaṇo devastatra kālena kenacit ।āgataḥ pitaraṁ draṣṭuṁ puṣpakeṇa dhaneśvaraḥ ।। 7.9.40 ॥

translations.english: Then, after some time, the god Vaishravana, the lord of wealth, came there in his Pushpaka chariot to see his father.
